CustomField.description: Whole days since this order was placed, for a pending order from the Hospitality Guide form being paid by check, and blank for everything else. Manual Reference is what scopes it: the org already holds dozens of pending manual checks entered by hand, and only an order placed through the form carries a reference. Deliberately measured from Created Date and NOT from Received At: nothing has been received, which is the entire point of the pending status, and Received At stays empty until a person banks the check. The Chase Pending Check Orders flow and the Awaiting a Check list view both read this, so the number the flow acts on is the one the office can see.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "pending"), ISPICKVAL(transaction_type__c, "Check"), NOT(ISBLANK(Manual_Reference__c)) ), FLOOR(NOW() - CreatedDate), NULL )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Days since the order was placed, while it waits on a check. Blank once it is no longer a pending check.
CustomField.label: Days Awaiting Check
